entries.3850afd8b59ed512: This is a business in which the group, as the investing entity, conducts investment activities. Centered on investment in rental real estate expected to generate stable medium- to long-term income, it holds and manages rental real estate as a portfolio while carrying out value-up and new development, and also makes investments in private equity, social infrastructure including renewable energy, and co-investments in private placement funds formed by the group (same-boat investments). It also provides advisory services such as business turnaround support and advice on M&A. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥17,193 million.

entries.7026fea150e99d96: This business conducts operation of accommodation facilities (facility operation). Its consolidated subsidiary First Brothers Hotels Co., Ltd. operates accommodation facilities such as hotels and ryokan, and provides hospitality services from a medium- to long-term perspective. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥1,794 million.

entries.bf45640bd22216fb: This is a manufacturing business for brewed beverages and other products, which was taken over together with real estate from the perspective of regional revitalization and is not included in a reportable segment.
entries.dca86c1875d87e2f: This business mainly conducts asset management for institutional investors. For private placement funds that invest in relatively large-scale real estate, it handles the full range of operations from planning and formulating investment strategies, acquiring investment properties, managing them during the term, to sale; it also entrusts asset management operations for interim management of real estate investments that investors conduct on their own initiative. This is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary First Brothers Investment Advisory Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥39 million.
